text: The traditional master-follower dynamic has a single point of failure. When the pioneer at the front takes a wrong turn, builds a flawed dogma, or dies without passing on the exact mechanics, an entire generation of followers gets trapped in a loop. They end up worshipping the ladder instead of climbing it, repeating the old techniques as rigid rituals without understanding why they were built in the first place. That’s how spiritual evolution stagnates into mere religion and obedience
